name: Ranger Space Ranger
body:
In more technologically advanced regions, some rangers patrol entire star systems or even wide swathes of the Galaxy. They use their knowledge of technology and alien biology to explore the stars and defend remote settlements.

Technologically Adept (Ex)

Handle Animal is not a class skill for you, but Knowledge (engineering) is. You are proficient with all firearms, but not with any kind of shields. Finally, you gain Technologist as a bonus feat at 1st level.

This feature alters class skills and weapon and armor proficiency, and replaces wild empathy.

Drone (Ex)

At 4th level, you gain a drone companion. This is a loyal construct that you build and maintain, and which accompanies you on you adventures. Your drone shares your favored enemy and favored terrain bonuses. This ability functions like the mechanic’s drone ability (which is part of the Artificial Intelligence class feature), except that your effective mechanic level is equal to your ranger level –3.

This feature replaces hunter’s bond.

Spellcasting

As a space ranger, you draw your spells from the mystic spell list instead of the usual ranger spell list. Only mystic spells up to 4th level are considered to be on your spell list, and all 0-level mystic spells are treated as 1st-level space ranger spells for the purposes of your spell list.

You otherwise prepare and cast your spells exactly the same as a standard ranger, including the number of spells that you can prepare per day and the fact that you cast them as divine spells.

This feature alters spells.

Quick Repair (Ex)

At 7th level, you can use make whole once per day as a spell-like ability that takes a full-round action to use. You can use this ability one additional time per day at 10th level and every 3 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5 times per day at 19th level.

This feature replaces woodland stride.
